articles.title: macOS development continues to hint at touchscreen MacBooks
articles.description: Apple's latest macOS 27.2 beta references new touch gestures for Safari and Notes, meaning we're in for a neat Sidecar upgrade, a touchscreen MacBook Pro , or both. macOS 27.2 beta 3 includes new touchscreen gestures for system apps. While rumors of a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen go back years , it looks as though the device is finally nearing release . Monday's macOS 27.2 beta indicates that multiple system applications will receive additional touch recognition capabilities. As MacRumors points out , the Notes app supports a feature dubbed "ICTouchPressGestureRecognizer," while QuickLook gained a "dragTouch" capability. Safari , meanwhile, was updated with a "touch sentinel recognizer," though these capabilities are only referenced in the software code. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: HeyPolo gives parents real-time visibility into how their teen is driving, all inside one app
articles.description: Do you remember the first time you backed out of the driveway on your own? It was pure freedom. For your parents? It was probably one of the most terrifying times of their life. When you were a teenager, your parents had no way to know how fast you were driving, when you arrived at your location, how safe you drove, etc. No news was good news, and hope was the only real tool available until you checked in with them. If you have teenage drivers today, rejoice in the fact that the fear of the unknown your parents had is not the world you have to live in today. There’s a lot of negatives with 2026 technology, but HeyPolo is a clear example of where technology has made life better and safer for teenage drivers. more…

articles.title: Siri AI & Smart Replies coming to the Apple TV, tvOS 27.2 code suggests
articles.description: We now have yet another indication that Apple Intelligence is coming to the next Apple TV 4K, with references to Apple's foundation models surfacing in a tvOS 27.2 beta. Siri AI & Smart Replies might be offered with the next-generation Apple TV 4K. Back in June 2026, tvOS 27 code suggested that the next-generation Apple TV 4K would support Siri AI. Apple's own software has once again referenced the same upgrade, which is both inevitable and an obvious choice at this point. On Monday, Apple released the third developer beta of tvOS 27.2. In the update, strings for the Settings app directly mention Apple's foundation models. "Help improve foundation models and Siri by allowing Apple to collect and use your text and audio interactions with Siri, Dictation, and Translate," says a description found in tvOS 27.2 beta 3.
